# Skyvelle

> Private jet charter across the United States with transparent hourly pricing, safety-audited operators and a 24/7 flight advisor.

Skyvelle is a private aviation broker. Flights are operated by independent FAA Part 135 carriers named on every quote. Prices on this site are indicative market ranges, not quotes.

## Key pages
- [Private jet charter](https://www.example.com/private-jet-charter/): how on-demand charter works
- [Instant quote](https://www.example.com/instant-quote/): request a quote and see an estimate
- [Private jet cost](https://www.example.com/private-jet-cost/): hourly rates by aircraft class and worked examples
- [Empty leg flights](https://www.example.com/empty-leg-flights/)
- [Jet card](https://www.example.com/jet-card/)
- [Safety](https://www.example.com/safety/): how operators are vetted
- [FAQ](https://www.example.com/faq/)

## Fleet
- [Light Jets](https://www.example.com/fleet/light-jets/): 4–7 seats, 2,100 mile range
- [Midsize Jets](https://www.example.com/fleet/midsize-jets/): 6–9 seats, 2,600 mile range
- [Super-Midsize Jets](https://www.example.com/fleet/super-midsize-jets/): 8–10 seats, 3,500 mile range
- [Heavy Jets](https://www.example.com/fleet/heavy-jets/): 10–16 seats, 4,500 mile range
- [Ultra-Long-Range Jets](https://www.example.com/fleet/ultra-long-range-jets/): 10–16 seats, 7,000 mile range
- [Turboprops](https://www.example.com/fleet/turboprops/): 4–9 seats, 1,700 mile range
